items.note: S2.1 states the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restoration on triples of a 100-set; sub-steps give the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three-stage composition, exactly as in the proof at 741-765. Wire counts (777-782) are not given but are not essential to the lemma.

S2.2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} with sign, and quotes the commutation reason; the invariant argument itself (804-813) is not unfolded, so I credit it as stated.

Statement matches Lemma lem:motif-residuals and 1105-1109 (nested nondegenerate labels in F^{otimes3}, only central 3->4 decreases losing h, L=Ich, sum Wm-2N+2L, ratios 100/539 and 101/539). The method follows the paper's route (forms, one tensor factor per stage, residual table), but the telescoping at gates with source total N and sink total Wm-N (891-894, 1066-1071) and the orthonormal binary bases needed later (1073-1102) are not given.

S2.4 assigns P_U to gates/sinks and -P_{U_a} to sources, uses rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one source exceptions, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m; this is the proof at 1156-1172.

Frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and C^{otimes m} on every role after Z corrections and i^{27k} are all stated; sub-steps follow 1231-1314 (weight additivity mod 4, Hadamard conjugation, Z/i^{27k} corrections, undoing the exchange).

The chain L/N<1/2 -> deficits -> s<Wm -> eta>20*2^{-50} -> s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} is present. The exact eta values and the step log m<20 giving m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta) (1331-1338) are missing, so the last implication is asserted rather than shown.
S1.1 and S1.2 state both lemmas correctly, including the b^{O(1)} offset-preparation condition; the S1 method is a one-line streaming slogan, not the paper's derivation (513-550, 574-639).

S3.1 states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and S3.2 states exactly a interchanges plus O(V); the elimination proof and the D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j one-interchange implementation (1432-1443) are not shown.

Statement (e=m^k, row field divisible by W^k, O(Ve^tau), F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1)) and route (cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, recursive edge shears, merge giving H<-H+D, three updates, geometric sum) match 1491-1557. The fixed-tape depth-first schedule that justifies the O(V) per-node term (1559-1615) is absent.
S3.4 states O(Vu^tau) for any u-bit chunks and names the high-digit row field and radix-q padding; the construction at 1649-1762 is not unfolded.

S4.1 (s_c child calls on f axes, C^{otimes e} on every role) and S4.2 (H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D) are correct and the method alludes to packed row additions for residual bases. The conjugation by P_M (eq:phase-edge-coordinate, 1849-1862) and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{otimes f}=(-i)^f Z C Z (1885-1888) are not given.

S4.3 describes the XOR of selected bits with a restored scratch chunk, whole-chunk cyclic shifts and a sorted correction of a bounded exceptional set, but gives neither delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} nor the time bound O(V(L^tau+1)+...).

The plan says the network recursion yields d^{lambda'} and that the recursion is scheduled on fixed tapes, but never states F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the leaf cutoff e<d^beta, the row-index construction, or the unrolling to lambda'.

S4/S4.6 state H_0 on one selected bit of up to d K-bit chunks, Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}, lambda'=1-2^{-54}; the method follows the paper (exact evaluation, guard width, b^D S_D C S_D, one truncation). The recurrence that yields d^{lambda'} is missing, and S4.5 gives only O(p) for the guard width where the paper has Delta=o(p).

Cost and error are correct and S5.1 gives the decimation-in-frequency step and bit-reversed order, but S5 calls the computed map F^-_t rather than its exact counterpart L B F^-_t (and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1}); character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I and the layout construction are not given.

S6.1 states exact multiplication by packing signed coefficients into integers for the O(N log N) multiplier, returning Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)); the evaluation point 2^{4p} and centered residues (3233-3368) are not shown.

Error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and cost are correct, and the route (two forward transforms kept in stored order, signed-packed products, opposite transform consuming that order) matches 3414-3420. The final exact scaling by M with the normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) (3421-3432) is missing.

S7.2 and S7.3 give P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions of error <p^2 and the tensor form RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A, but omit the hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4, the value gamma=2d alpha^2 and the costs; the one-dimensional construction (3576-3792) is not shown.
Both identities, QF_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T with the stated chirp and (RF_s^+)[(RF_s u)(RF_s v)]=(u*v)/S^2, are stated correctly; their proofs (3938-3988) are not given.
Exponents and size parameters are stated correctly, but the prime source lengths (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i, eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma, and t_i in {r/2,r} are absent.

Phi, mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, isomorphism and the triangular formula are correct and follow 4216-4231; the padded-box handling, axis reversal by chunk swaps and the cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) (4232-4291) are missing.

S10.2 states x_d -> zeta y, zeta=e^{pi i/r}, turning the last-axis cyclic convolution into R_r multiplication with correct wrap sign; the formula M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) is not given.

The source-transform composition with counterpart RF_s and the sequence Phi, two transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding and carries follow the paper. The digit scaling 2^{-b-2} that explains 2^{2b+4}, the definition of F^+ by complex conjugation (4478-4484) and the inverse map Phi^{-1} before carrying (4528-4529) are absent.
Only the conclusion 'final error below 1/2, so rounding is exact' is given; the error chain E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L and 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4 is missing.

The route (divide by V=Tp, powers of p, margins with minimum 2^{-181}=2kappa, log powers absorbed by p^kappa, schoolbook below a cutoff) is the paper's, but the seven table terms and which margin is minimal (g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)) are not listed, and setup/prime-search costs o(V) are not addressed.
S0 relies on the n log n conjecture and its motivation mentions going below n log n, but no step states the liminf criterion or why the bound refutes the eventual lower bound.

errors.says: The procedure computes the multidimensional synthetic transform F^-_t (and its opposite) with the stated error and cost.
errors.paper: The forward procedure's exact counterpart is L B F^-_t, including an explicit layout permutation L and bit-reversal B; the opposite procedure has counterpart F^+_t B^{-1} L^{-1}.

errors.says: The 2n-bit product is the carried radix-2^b digit list of 2^{2b+4} S w, with w=(u*v)/S computed from the CRT-mapped arrays; the method goes rescale, round, propagate carries.
errors.paper: 2^{2b+4} S w is the integer coefficient array in tensor (CRT) order; after rounding, Phi^{-1} must restore ordinary coefficient order before carries are propagated.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the fixed network (S2) through frames, labels, the two interfaces and the explicit saving to the interchange recurrence (S3), the simultaneous layer (S4), synthetic transforms and convolution (S5-S6), resampling with retained permutations (S7), and the CRT/twist/multiplication assembly (S10-S11). The address-movement half is reconstructed in detail. It thins out in the butterfly half: the layer recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and its unrolling to lambda' are never stated, and the packed-addition cost, the error chain to 1/2 and the individual cost-table terms are asserted rather than shown.

steps.note: h=100 triples, banks X_a,Y_a, m=10^6 and the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring all scratch are present; N=binom(h,3)^3 is used in Wm-2N+2L but never defined, a small gap.
Common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1} and route operator D_sink D_source^{-1}; the role of cheap edge changes is in S2.3's motivation.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{otimes3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, only central 3->4 edges decrease, each losing h.
S2.4's motivation states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate subspaces, and S2.4.1 names the N rank-one source edges as the only excess.
Sum of |dim changes| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, are both stated.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m are all stated.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a and I_m for every other role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge shear applied by recursive interchanges; the total s per node is implicit in the recurrence rather than stated in words.

Streams of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta>20*2^{-50} giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are present; the auxiliary fact log m<20 used to pass from eta to tau is not stated.

central.summary: P06 reconstructs the central saving essentially in full: the h=100 bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the only loss on central 3->4 edges, rank equals dimension change with N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, rank-many recursive interchanges per edge, and the recurrence to O(e^tau) with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only gaps are that N is never defined and that the step log m<20 is left out.
